title: Shark eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water-less background: dark screen handled globally; use bright shapes only -->

  <path d='M18 62 Q22 44 42 42 Q62 40 74 52 Q82 58 84 66 Q76 70 68 68 Q60 74 50 74 Q34 74 24 70 Q18 68 18 62 Z' fill='#4FC3F7'/>

  <path d='M30 66 Q42 72 56 70 Q66 68 72 66 Q64 70 52 72 Q38 72 30 66 Z' fill='#B3E5FC'/>

  <path d='M44 42 Q48 28 58 34 Q52 40 50 44 Z' fill='#29B6F6'/>

  <path d='M18 62 Q10 50 14 44 Q20 54 26 58 Z' fill='#29B6F6'/>
  <path d='M18 64 Q8 72 12 78 Q20 70 26 68 Z' fill='#0288D1'/>

  <path d='M48 66 Q44 78 54 76 Q52 70 56 68 Z' fill='#0288D1'/>

  <path d='M72 54 Q84 56 86 64 Q80 70 72 66 Q76 60 72 54 Z' fill='#8E1B4F'/>

  <circle cx='56' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#E1F5FE'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#01579B'/>
  <!-- gill lines -->
  <path d='M50 52 Q48 58 50 64' stroke='#0288D1' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M56 54 Q54 60 56 65' stroke='#0288D1' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
</svg>
